caption: The drawing depicts a single, metallic lantern with a square body and slightly rounded top, featuring a prominent circular red lens on its front side. The lantern is rendered in shades of brown and gray, with some areas showing a rusty or weathered appearance. Attached to the top is a curved metallic handle fixed with a bracket on each side, and there is a smaller cylindrical section on the top part of the lantern’s body. The red lens at the front is circular and textured with concentric ridges. The composition is centered, and the object is depicted in a three-quarter view, positioned against a plain, light beige background. There is no additional ornamentation or objects in the drawing.
title: Railway Lantern
